identity.summary: UFC lists the Swiss bantamweight; an IJF judoka of the same name competed for Switzerland.

national.note: IJF entrant lists name a Swiss judoka Stephanie EGGER (IJF person 4115) at the 2011 Paris Grand Slam (−70 kg), lost her first contest. The IJF data hides birth dates, so identity with the UFC fighter is not yet established. Resolve with a source linking the UFC fighter to judo for Switzerland.
